Zari Elephant

The pride of Verity is the zari elephant. While the location of wild zari is currently unknown, trainers who complete the region’s Circuit Run and impress the merchant lords of Verity are given single opportunity each year to try and capture one of the rare monsters. So far, only two trainers, Daniel of the town of Quill and the researcher Jenna, have ever succeeded at capturing their earned zari elephants.

Monster Trainer Spells
Monstorin Stats

ZARI ELEPHANT
CR 14

XP 38,400
N Huge outsider (air, extraplanar)
Init +2; Senses Perception +25

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 6, flat-footed 27 (–2 Dex, +21 natural, –2 size)
hp 204 (19d10+95)
Fort +16, Ref +11, Will +15
Immune all-around vision, two minds

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 50 ft. (good)
Melee gore +25 (2d8+12), slam +20 (1d8+4), stomp +20 (2d6+12)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 5 ft. (slam, 15 ft.)
Special Attacks dual missiles, powerful charge (gore, 4d6+16)

STATISTICS

Str 26, Dex 6, Con 20, Int 16, Wis 14, Cha 16
Base Atk +19; CMB +29; CMD 38 (42 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Casting, Greater Bull Rush, Greater Overrun, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Attack (gore), Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Weapon Focus (gore)
Skills Appraise +22, Climb +16, Fly +17, Knowledge (arcana, nature, nobility, religion) +22, Perception +25, Sense Motive +21, Stealth +0
Languages Common; truespeech
SQ trainer spells (CL 14th)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

All-Around Vision (Ex)

Zari elephants gain a +4 bonus on all Perception checks and cannot be flanked.

Dual Missiles (Su)

Zari elephants can cast two magic missile spells at a time, using two trainer spell slots as appropriate. A zari elephant can use any 1st-level or higher trainer spell slots to cast magic missile in this way (or 4th-level or higher, if quickened). This does not count as quickening a spell.

Two Minds (Ex)

Zari elephants are immune to mind-affecting effects unless they choose to be affected. A zari elephant that loses one of its heads (such as when struck by a vorpal weapon) does not die immediately, but does lose this immunity.
